text:
Ellen: Quick heads-up 8am PT launch9: we published 'community-health-dashboard' v1.0.0 to help maintainers track contribution metrics, incident trends, and registry sync status. :sparkles:
Ellen: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-health-dashboard (release v1.0.0)
Ellen: TL;DR: lightweight dashboard, pluggable metrics collectors for GitHub & CI, suggested alert rules for stale PRs and failing smoke tests, and a templated weekly health report.
community-bot: release published: community-health-dashboard@v1.0.0 1 assets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-health-dashboard/releases/tag/v1.0.0 1 changelog: "initial dashboard + collectors + weekly-report template"
Jorge: This looks great. Are the collectors supposed to run as GitHub Actions or a sidecar?
Ellen: Both supported. We ship a GitHub Action for small orgs and a docker-compose example for self-hosted installs. See docs/deployment.md.
KB: Any PII considerations for the weekly report?
Ellen: Good call. The default report anonymizes user IDs and surfaces counts only. We added guidance in docs/privacy.md for teams that want full names (requires opt-in and a CLA/GDPR review).
Nora: Can we hook this up to the community-runbooks repo to show incident response lag? Would be useful for maintainers.
Ellen: Absolutely 5 added an example connector in integrations/community-runbooks.md that pulls incident open/close timestamps. PRs welcome to expand connectors.
Jorge: Will the dashboard send alerts to Slack?
Ellen: Yes 1 optional Slack webhook notifier + webhook templating. We included an example alert mapping file under configs/alerts.yaml.
KB: Licensing? Is this permissive for forks?
Ellen: MIT for the dashboard core; collectors are MIT as well. We included notes for enterprise forks in docs/enterprise-notes.md (secrets, KMS recommendations).
community-bot: Notice: onboarding checklist created: /docs/maintainer-quickstart.md
Nora: Can someone demo this at the next contributor call? I can host a 20-min walkthrough.
Ellen: Love that 1 scheduled for Monday 10am PT and will post details in community calendar. Signup: https://cal.com/redwood/community-dashboard-walkthrough
Jorge: Minor nit: the repo README references an older Node version. I'll open a PR to update to 18.x.
Ellen: Thanks Jorge  appreciated. If you find any missing metrics you'd like, open an issue and tag it `enhancement`. Big thanks to @Jorge @KB and the early testers for the fast feedback. :clap:
